description: Tasks. fetch.max_files: how many files one `task fetch` may copy. task_file_reminder: a prompt that wrote task files but not TASK.md is asked once, at Stop, to update it. review: a task with [review]=n may use n + extra_checks checks before a person must allow more; max_n caps the n a prompt can ask for. snapshots: how long the copies made at the gates are kept, and the largest file that is copied. report.copilot_events: the task report and the board read Copilot's own session record (~/.copilot/session-state/<session>/events.jsonl) for time and usage, numbers only; false: the hook log only, no usage. mapreduce: after the user typed /generic-mapreduce, the session may call the read-only mapper subagent max_agents times within that many minutes; 0 turns it off.
